extraction.notes: Three months ended Dec 31, 2023 column only. Source table is on seq 11 (printed page not marked; the same reconciliation is repeated on seq 17, printed S-3, which matches). No AFFO metric is presented in these pages, so affo fields are null. Share count printed as 66,447,394 and converted to thousands (66,447.394); it reproduces FFO/share 3.87 (257,289/66,447.394) and Core FFO/share 3.83 (254,333/66,447.394). Impairment loss from unconsolidated co-investments (33,700) was classified as re_impairment; it is a co-investment impairment, so the classification is an interpretation. 'Depreciation attributable to third party ownership and other' (379) was classified as noncontrolling_interest, also an interpretation. Zero-valued dash lines are included with amount 0. Recurring capex not disclosed in these pages (null). Arithmetic verified: FFO and Core FFO subtotals tie to the printed totals.
